cards.quote: Steeves Brenet, a name that would become synonymous with French politics, began his journey in a humble socio-professional category – that of a technician. Growing up in a working-class family, Steeves was instilled with a strong work ethic and a passion for problem-solving. As a young man, he was drawn to the world of technology, where he could apply his analytical mind to create innovative solutions. It was only natural, then, that he would pursue a career as a technician.
